$schema_note: Machine-enforced allowlist for the SCA (npm audit) gate. Read the policy first: docs/EXTERNAL_FINDINGS_POLICY.md. Enforced by tools/sca_gate.py (blocking CI step in .github/workflows/adversarial-review.yml). This file NEVER covers trust-invariant gates (trust_gate/evaluator/eval-harness/RLS) — it is only for external dependency/tooling findings we cannot fix under our own control.
rules_enforced_by_tool: Every high/critical production advisory MUST be either fixed or listed here — an unlisted one FAILS the gate.
An entry suppresses ONLY while the scanner reports fixAvailable=false for its package. The moment a fix ships, fixAvailable flips and the gate FAILS — forcing the upgrade (anti-rot).
An entry past its 'expires' date FAILS the gate — forcing periodic human + evaluator re-review.
A STALE entry (its advisory no longer appears in the audit — i.e. it was fixed/removed) FAILS the gate, forcing deletion so dead exceptions cannot accrete.
A malformed entry or an unreadable allowlist FAILS the gate (fail-closed).
Entries are scoped to an exact (package, ghsa). No wildcards.
